qualifiedVerdicts.content: Blind facet-split reviews of the staged candidate tree c82e94b and serialized fix rechecks of the revised tree 80c7336, committed signed as 174d0cc, found the original quiz-safety and comprehensibility defects resolved; correctness and scoped coverage were clean from the start. 移動 now guards 動かす (and, conservatively, 動く); 穀物 translates 米や麦 as «рис и пшеницу или ячмень» and explains that 穀物 names grain or grain crops in general; 積む says «Я сложил три коробки стопкой»; 積極的 drops a warning that depended on English "positive"; 神経 states that 経 also means «сутра» before rejecting the literal «писание бога»; and 祭 turns EN's dictionary-scope remark into learner guidance. Final verdicts: correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN; comprehensibility CLEAN; consistency CLEAN; quiz safety CLEAN within reviewed batch scope. Full initial reviewer reports, reconciliation, the preserved author/reviewer required-versus-conservative exclusion classification and process notes, including the staged-tree review while commit signing was unavailable, are attached. No native-speaker, app-import, device, learner, voice, drawing, runtime or ordinary-release acceptance is claimed.

qualifiedVerdicts.quizTitles: All 16 EN exclusions across 12 lists are retained. The reviewed RU title overlaps received 28 direct, one-sided exclusions on 15 new cards: 立ち上がる–上がる; 空き–席; 積む–折る; 穀物–米; 稼ぐ–働く; 根–原因; 種–話題; 移動–移す/移る/動かす/動く; 禁煙–禁止; 祭–お祭り/お祝い/祝い; 祝う–お祝い/祝い; 祝い–お祝い/プレゼント/贈り物/お土産/お祭り/記念; 感謝–恩; 礼–恩; 確認–チェック/テスト/調べる. Two were added after review: 移動–動かす, answering the consistency finding, and 移動–動く, a conservative coordinator guard because «перемещение; передвижение» shares the stem of «двигаться» and 移動する is taught both transitively and intransitively. Android applies each declaration symmetrically, so no reverse declarations were added to baseline cards.
